title: Deep learning enables discovery of highly potent anti-osteoporosis natural products.
summary: Prospective natural-product screening yielded five active hits among ten tested, including new-scaffold osteoclastogenesis inhibitors with follow-up expression assays. No clinical efficacy established.
organization: Guangdong Academy of Sciences; Sun Yat-sen University; Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: Prospective natural-product screening yielded five active hits among ten tested, including new-scaffold osteoclastogenesis inhibitors with follow-up expression assays. No clinical efficacy established.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Pretrained self-attentive message-passing neural network (P-SAMPNN) is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
